No `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash`, or other dangerous command executions appear at the top level. The `package()` function and all other function bodies are out of scope for this gate, as `makepkg --printsrcinfo` does not execute them. There is no code that would download and execute untrusted payloads, exfiltrate data, or perform any action beyond normal variable assignments during the sourcing phase.
</details>
